job.description:
We already have the front-end template for a domain landing page. Now I need the backend layer that makes it work across a large domain portfolio.

Each domain should use the same shared template, but the content must change dynamically based on the hostname.

What I need:
- hostname-based routing
- a simple way to map domains to content
- support for Norwegian, Swedish, and English
- a practical contact form solution
- a way to add or update domains without editing the template manually every time
- clean, maintainable code and deployment instructions

The backend should:
- detect the requested hostname
- load the correct content for that domain
- inject the right domain name, status text, CTA label, meta text, and language-specific text
- handle contact form submissions
- keep the system simple and inexpensive to run

I’m open to the implementation, but I expect a good proposal to explain whether you would use:
- Cloudflare Workers with hostname routing and a small data store, or
- a dedicated form backend for the contact form, if that is the simpler option

If you recommend a third-party form service, please explain why it is the better choice here and how submissions would be handled.

Please avoid unnecessary frameworks and overengineering. I’m looking for a lightweight, maintainable solution that will be easy to extend later.

In your proposal, please include:
- your suggested architecture
- how hostname-to-content mapping would work
- how you would handle the contact form
- any relevant experience with Cloudflare Workers, routing, or similar multi-domain setups
- your fixed price for the work
